Silence in the desert is deceptive. Usually broken only by the wind shifting the sands, yet this time is different. Under the scorching sun, shadows take on a life of their own, and shapes emerge from the dunes that do not belong to this world.

Aethernal AI invites you on a journey to the Silver Cities, where magic is power, and knowledge – a weapon. In this episode from the world of Heroes 5, a lone hero uncovers a terrifying truth hidden within the ancient mines. What seems like an anomaly turns out to be a harbinger of impending danger.
